title: Characterizing Network Structure of Anti-Trans Actors on TikTok

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and RAG-enhanced LLM classification performance (precision, recall, F1) on a curated dataset of TikTok videos using a custom taxonomy. The study measures the model's failure rates in recognizing nuanced anti-trans rhetoric and gender-queer in-group language, identifying a cis-normative bias where the model disproportionately labels trans-related content as neutral.
